common_conventions.potential: Real-valued, mean-zero, period-one functions on T=R/Z. The same physical KdV Birkhoff map Omega is used in all statements.
common_conventions.coordinate_indices: n >= 1, with two real coordinates x_n,y_n; no n=0 action or signed duplicate
common_conventions.topologies: Sobolev and weighted Hilbert norm topologies; weighted actions use the indicated l1 norm. Bi-analyticity means real analytic maps with real analytic inverse in these norm topologies.
common_conventions.poisson: Gardner bracket integral (d_u F)*partial_x(d_u G); {x_n,y_m}=delta_nm, {x_n,x_m}={y_n,y_m}=0. This sign must not be inherited from the accepted NLS convention.
common_conventions.hill: L(q)=-d^2/dx^2+q on [0,2] with periodic boundary conditions, q period one. Fourier basis exp(i*pi*k*x); free spectral value pi^2*k^2. Formula (2), page 5, fixes the second derivative; the page-8 display has an omitted exponent.
common_conventions.spectral_labels: lambda_0^+, then pairs lambda_n^-,lambda_n^+ for n>=1, ordered lexicographically for complex q. Free n=0 is simple and n>=1 double; no perturbed multiplicity theorem is proved by the candidate.
common_conventions.contour_action: I_n=(1/pi) integral_Gamma_n lambda*Delta'(lambda)/sqrt_c(Delta(lambda)^2-4) d_lambda, with the branch/circuit conventions on pages 9-10. Higher actions J_(n,m) have lambda^(m+1)/((m+1)*pi).

main_statements.label: Theorem 1
main_statements.quantifier_order: Fix the same Omega; for every integer m>=1, there exist c_m>0,d_m>0, independent of u, such that for every u in H_0^m both estimates hold.
main_statements.adapter_constants: An action-bound constant C or D gives coordinate-bound constant 2*C or 2*D. These adapters require the physical identities and action bounds explicitly; they do not prove those hypotheses.

main_statements.label: Theorem 2
main_statements.quantifier_order: For every integer m>=1, there exist c_m>0,d_m>0 before quantifying every u in H_0^m.
main_statements.remaining: Construct physical Hill actions, trace identities, spectral localization, and the forward/inverse estimates. Generic NLS action estimates alone do not establish these assertions.

main_statements.label: Theorem 3
main_statements.domain: w_n=(1+|n|)^r*v_n, 0<=r<=1/2, v in M; H_0^w and h_*^w with weights w_(2*n), not w_n.
main_statements.weight_class: M: w_n>=1, w_(-n)=w_n, w_(n+k)<=w_n*w_k, and w_|n|<=w_(|n|+1). Piecewise linear interpolation to R is used in evaluating the bound.
main_statements.quantifier_order: For each admissible w,r there exists c_(w,r)>0 independent of u, then for every u in H_0^w, Omega(u) belongs to h_*^w and both estimates hold.
main_statements.remaining: Reuse SpectralWeight for M, prove the interpolation interface and weighted Hill gap/action estimates, then identify them with the physical Omega and its image space.

associated_corollaries.label: Corollary 1 (first occurrence)
associated_corollaries.scope: For integer m>=1, a global KdV solution with u(0)=u0 in H_0^m satisfies ||u(t)||_m<=alpha_m*(||u0||_m+(1+||u0||_(m-1))^(m^2+m-1)*||u0||_(m-1)) for every real t; alpha_m independent of u0,t.

associated_corollaries.label: Corollary 1 (second occurrence)
associated_corollaries.scope: For every real s>=0, exists c_s uniform in u in H_0^s: S_s<=c_s*(1+A_s)^max(1,s)*A_s and Q_(2*s+1)<=c_s^2*(1+A_s)^(2*max(1,s))*A_s^2, including the mapping property into h_*^s.

new_proved_foundation.source_correspondence: The free Fourier denominator and complementary inverse used in the proof of Lemma A.3, page 27, after the P_n/Q_n splitting on page 26. This is not Lemma A.3's full convolution estimate ||V*A_lambda^-1*Q_n||<=2*||q||_w/n.
new_proved_foundation.strip: For n>=1: |Re(lambda)-pi^2*n^2|<=6*n. This explicit narrower strip replaces the printed radius 12*n for this candidate; no downstream localization constants are yet claimed.
new_proved_foundation.domains_and_topologies: Complex Coeff p and WeightedCoeff w p, with 1<=p<=infinity and their Banach norms; arbitrary positive weight w. The reciprocal multiplier is zero when |k|=n and inverse(lambda-pi^2*k^2) otherwise.
new_proved_foundation.proved_bounds: |n^2-k^2|<=||lambda-pi^2*k^2|| for |k|!=n, and operator application norms <=(1/n)*||a|| for both unweighted and weighted spaces. The pointwise right inverse is the projection deleting the two resonant modes; uniqueness includes that deletion explicitly.
new_proved_foundation.not_claimed: No construction of perturbed Hill spectrum, periodic differential operator domain, discriminant, contour action, canonical coordinates or Birkhoff map. No result for the printed wider strips follows merely by renaming this strip.

continued_proved_foundation.source_correspondence: Lemma A.3, PDF/printed page 27, and the Neumann inversion at the start of page 28, on the explicit narrower radius-6*n strips.
proved: The actual complementary reciprocal symbol belongs to l2 with norm at most 4/n; this follows from the existing reciprocal series estimates via two translated punctured lattices.
hillComplementToL1 is a continuous linear map from weighted l2 to weighted l1 with the literal reciprocal coefficient formula and bound 4/n.
hillTailPerturbation is the literal weighted convolution q*(A_lambda^-1 Q_n a), with operator norm at most 4*||q||_w/n.
The l2-to-l1 and tail perturbation bounds hold uniformly for every integer shift of the weighted norm.

When n>=8*||q||_w, the tail operator has norm at most 1/2, and id minus that operator admits an actual two-sided bounded inverse of norm at most 2. The existence proof reuses NLS.exists_inverse_norm_le_two_mul_of_composition_near.
continued_proved_foundation.constant_changes: Uses 4/n for the summability and tail estimates, cutoff 8*||q||, and strip radius 6*n; no assertion of the printed 2/n estimate or radius 12*n follows.
continued_proved_foundation.essential_missing_identifications: This is the period-two Fourier coefficient realization for a general weighted potential sequence. Physical function/operator domain identification, embedding of period-one potentials with the source w_(2n) convention, two-mode Schur complement and eigenvalue counting/localization remain to be proved.

two_mode_reduction.source_correspondence: Appendix A, page 28: S_n=A_lambda-P_n*T_hat_n*V, the one-to-one correspondence of nontrivial solutions, and the effective determinant criterion.
two_mode_reduction.statement: For a positive integer n, |Re(z)-pi^2*n^2|<=6*n, and n>=8*||q||_w, the determinant of the constructed operator on C x C vanishes iff there exists a nonzero weighted l1 sequence f with (z-pi^2*k^2)*f_k=(q*f)_k for every integer k. Reconstruction and resonant coefficient extraction recover the solutions in both directions. The full potential is the literal weighted convolution.
two_mode_reduction.free_case: At zero potential the constructed operator is (z-pi^2*n^2)*id, and its determinant is exactly (z-pi^2*n^2)^2.
two_mode_reduction.not_assumed: No unspecified finite block, arbitrary spectral package, or unproved inverse hypothesis is supplied by a caller. The bounded inverse is chosen from the previously proved existence theorem.
two_mode_reduction.remaining_qualifications: No claim yet that a zero of this determinant has the corresponding algebraic multiplicity as a physical periodic Hill eigenvalue. Analytic dependence on z and q, equality of the two diagonal correction terms, the H2 differential-operator domain identification, and eigenvalue labeling/localization remain to be proved.
